observations: Photo 0 shows two retail boxes for a Blue Gate UPS stacked on top of each other.
The boxes are labeled 'BLUE GATE Line Interactive UPS BG1530 Elite Pro'.
The actual UPS units are not visible in the photo; only the packaging is shown.
The boxes appear to be in good condition, placed on a concrete floor against a blue wall.
There is a watermark 'OLWELL COMPUTERS LTD NG' across the center of the image.

risks.proof: A photo of the actual UPS units outside of their boxes.

risks.risk: The internal lead-acid batteries may be depleted or dead from long-term storage or previous use.
risks.proof: A video showing the UPS powering a significant load (like a PC) while disconnected from mains power.

risks.risk: The units may be used or refurbished rather than new, despite the boxes.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the units from all angles, specifically the rear outlets and the serial number sticker.

proof_requests: Photos of the actual UPS units removed from the boxes.
A photo of the specification sticker on the back or side of the actual unit.
A video of the unit turned on and supporting a load without being plugged into the wall.
response.reason: Only the retail boxes are shown. I cannot verify the existence, physical condition, or authenticity of the UPS units without seeing them outside of the packaging.
